text: Sorry, I know this is probably the last thing you need at this time of night and I feel daft messaging. My son is 11 and he's got a really runny nose, then blocked, then runny again, and he's been sneezing loads all evening. That's honestly all it is. I just wasn't sure if there's anything I should be giving him or if I just let it run its course. Sorry again for bothering you.
